native.host.share.title: Open this folder from your other computers?
native.host.share.read: Your signed-in computers can read “{name}” while this computer is online.
native.host.share.write: Your signed-in computers can read and edit “{name}” while this computer is online.
native.host.remove.title: Stop access to this folder?
native.host.remove.message: Other computers signed into your account will no longer be able to open it.
native.host.share.detail: Files pass through PuppyOne Cloud only while they are opened and are not stored there. You can stop this at any time.
native.host.share.background: Sharing continues while PuppyOne is closed, as long as this computer is on. Pause it here at any time.
native.host.revoke.title: Remove this computer?
native.host.revoke.message: Its folders will no longer open from your other computers. Opening them again sets it up as a new computer.
native.host.execution.title: Run things in this folder from your other computers?
native.host.execution.message: Your signed-in computers will be able to run what you allow in “{name}” — a terminal, Git or an Agent — with this computer's files, programs and sign-ins.
native.host.execution.detail: Commands run on this computer as you. Only allow this for folders and computers you trust. You can stop all running sessions at any time.
native.host.execution.sandboxed: Your signed-in computers will be able to run what you allow in “{name}” — a terminal, Git or an Agent — inside a sandbox on this computer.
native.host.execution.sandboxedDetail: In the sandbox they can change only this folder, and cannot read your SSH keys, keychain, browser data or PuppyOne sign-in. They can still read other files and use the network. You can stop all running sessions at any time.
native.host.execution.unavailable: This computer has no sandbox for running things inside “{name}”. To let your other computers run a terminal, Git or an Agent here, first allow running on the whole computer.
native.host.whole.title: Let your other computers run things on this whole computer?
native.host.whole.message: Terminals, Git and Agents started from your signed-in computers will run here as you, outside any sandbox: they can read and change every file you can, and use your sign-ins and keys.
native.host.whole.detail: Only turn this on if you trust every computer signed in to your account. Turning it off ends every session that runs outside the sandbox.
native.execution.title: Manage Running Sessions…
native.execution.inventory: Select an Agent or Terminal instance. This list remains available after its tab closes.
native.execution.consequence: Termination stops this local instance, but does not undo completed work or confirm cancellation of remote jobs.
native.execution.state.pending: This instance has not been terminated.
native.execution.state.running: Termination accepted. Waiting for resource exit confirmation.
native.execution.state.unconfirmed: Cleanup is unconfirmed. Resource ownership is retained; you can retry.

native.projectClose.detail: The window will stay open. Try closing it again to finish stopping these tasks.
